title: Frontend: Validate Palindrome
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Validate Palindrome. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Implement solution(text). Keep only ASCII letters/digits, compare case-insensitively, and return whether the normalized string is a palindrome. Empty normalized text is a palindrome.
constraints: Define solution(input) in plain JavaScript. Return the documented JSON-compatible value or throw the documented validation error. Each case receives a fresh input.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.

testCases.name: Behavioral case 1
testCases.inputDescription: "A man, a plan, a canal: Panama"

hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Normalize the string according to the contract, then compare characters from both ends while moving inward.
alternativeApproaches: Compare a strict literal palindrome checker with a locale-aware user-text variant.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Empty normalized text; punctuation; mixed case.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
